answer_1.quote: For generative backbones (i.e., decoder-only backbones), we train the model to output the class name with causal language modelling loss.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs class names in natural language format using prompts such as "Input sentence: {text}\n The label: {label}{eos token}".

answer_2.quote: For sentence-level classification tasks, we report the accuracy. For word-level classification tasks, we report the macro-f1 due to the class imbalance.
